tool_args.rationale: The pilot signatures and recalled mechanism support cooperative Hill-2 saturation with competitive gradient inhibition and linear bleed. Numerically fit all four parameters and use fresh confirmation to test the hypothesis.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five observations span s_grad from 0.25 to 2.25, so the cited narrow-gradient ambiguity does not apply.
They omit the observed gradient-dependent inhibition captured by the recalled Hill mechanism.
The proposed algebraic mechanism has four fitted parameters and five observations at the target horizon; a trajectory batch is not needed to resolve the stated ambiguity.
